_doc: The one list of models, files, licences and settings. Paths are inside the PC's work folder (C:/lazylink by default). Sampler settings come from ComfyUI's own templates. `imagegen.py fetch` downloads only from the official repos listed here and checks size + sha256 before a file is used.

comfy._doc: our own pinned ComfyUI, installed by `imagegen.py setup` into tools/ (any ComfyUI you already have is never touched)
comfy._warm_doc: between jobs the PC's runner keeps ONE ComfyUI up (Windows): the next image/sound/3D/video job reuses it and skips the start (~20 s) and, with the same model, the model load (~5 s). It stops before any job that does not ask for it (Blender, voice, setup, ...), after warm_idle_s with no job, after warm_max_age_s, or when a job fails. LAZY_WARM=0 on the Mac turns it off. server_args: {scratch} = RENDER_ROOT/tmp/comfy, {port} = port

uv._doc: uv (Astral, MIT/Apache-2.0) installs Python without admin rights; pinned release, sha256 from its GitHub release page

linux._doc: same release, Linux builds (the Linux PC's job scripts read these; sha256 from the release's .sha256 files)

mac._doc: same release, macOS builds (the Mac's job scripts read these; sha256 from the release's GitHub asset digests)

cutout._doc: asks with "cutout": true also get <name>__<model>-cutout.png (transparent background). BiRefNet HR-matting since 2026-11-10 (owner pick after the bake-off): the same network, size and speed as BiRefNet, trained for soft edges, so hair, fur, glass and smoke keep partial transparency. Version 1 was plain BiRefNet (birefnet.safetensors, still under files).
cutout._snap_doc: alpha at or under 6 becomes fully clear, at or over 240 fully solid (pc/batch.py snap_alpha): HR-matting leaves solid things at 240-254, which shows a faint ghost of the background in a game. Soft edges (fur, glass, smoke) sit between and are kept.

defaults._doc: the picture model imagegen.py uses when none is named. Bump a model's or recipe's "version" whenever its settings or files change, so anything made with the old one can be found and re-made.

zimage.label: Z-Image Turbo (6B)
zimage.licence: Apache-2.0: free for any commercial use

klein.label: FLUX.2 klein 4B
klein.licence: Apache-2.0: free for any commercial use

krea2.label: Krea 2 Turbo
krea2.licence: Krea 2 Community: commercial use free while total yearly revenue < $1M

krea2raw.label: Krea 2 Raw
krea2raw.licence: Krea 2 Community: commercial use free while total yearly revenue < $1M
krea2raw._doc: undistilled base, meant for training LoRAs (Krea: train on Raw, run on Turbo); 52 steps, cfg 3.5 per krea-ai/krea-2 README

moss.label: MOSS-Image Base (5B, int8)
moss.licence: Apache-2.0: free for any commercial use (OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-Image-Base; ComfyUI repack Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image)
moss._doc: bake-off candidate 2026-11-10, not a default: settings from ComfyUI's image_moss_image_base_t2i template (25 steps, cfg 2.5, er_sde, skip layer 22 on the negative branch for the first half), prompt enhancer off

klein3.label: FLUX 3 Image Klein (distilled, bf16)
klein3.licence: FLUX Kommunity License (a community licence): commercial use free while yearly revenue < US$5M, if every output is reviewed (or content-filtered) before it is shown and AI use is disclosed where the law asks (black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein, gated: the user accepts the terms on Hugging Face)
klein3._doc: the default picture model since 2026-11-10 (owner pick after the bake-off: 10.7 s per 1024 picture on a 3090 vs 15.9 s for Krea 2 Turbo, and best at text in pictures): settings from ComfyUI's image_flux3_klein_distilled_t2i template (15 steps, cfg 1, er_sde), its prompt upsampler off. Files from the base repo (its model.safetensors and ae.safetensors have the same sha256 as the ComfyUI repack's klein bf16 and flux2-vae; the repack repo is gated apart); text encoder: Krea 2's Qwen3-VL-4B fp8 (same architecture as the template's qwen3vl_4b). Gated files: keydrop run HF_TOKEN -- imagegen.py fetch --models klein3

recipes._doc: converted ComfyUI templates (recipes/<template>.api.json, made by `imagegen.py convert`; the exception is moge_maps, hand-written: see its _doc); params map a short name to [node id, input]; fixed = always set

sfx.label: Stable Audio 3 small SFX
sfx.licence: Stability AI Community: free while yearly revenue < $1M

music3.label: MiniMax Music 3
music3.licence: MiniMax-Music3 Community (upstream LICENSE; the ComfyUI repack's apache-2.0 tag does not override it): commercial use free while yearly revenue < $20M, BUT a product that uses it must show "MiniMax-Music3" in its interface, and output put in public must say it is machine-made (AUP 11)
music3._doc: the pick for game music since 2026-11-10 (owner, after the bake-off). Version 2: takes the same prompt/seconds/seed asks as audio (prompt = caption, lyrics "[Instrumental]" unless an ask sets them), so refresh-kit can switch a kind to it. caption: Global Metadata (genre, BPM, key, mood) then Arrangement; lyrics: section tags only, "[Instrumental]" for no vocals; seconds = max_duration (the model picks the length up to it)

audio.label: Stable Audio 3 medium
audio.licence: Stability AI Community: free while yearly revenue < $1M

mesh.label: Pixal3D + TRELLIS.2 (image to textured 3D model)
mesh._limits_doc: imagegen make refuses asks outside these. texture = the colour/normal map size in px, never on/off (true read as 1 = a 1x1 black colour map, SCZ 2026-11-04); faces = the game mesh after decimation, 4000-5000 for phone props (the normal map is baked from the dense mesh, so detail stays)
mesh._doc: game-ready defaults: 40k faces, 2048 texture (the template's 700k / 4096 is for film); prompt text = the input picture
mesh._min_vram_note: check.py estimate: 3D needs far more working memory than its files; measured only on a 24 GB card

maps.label: MoGe-2 (picture to normal map + depth)
maps.licence: MIT: any commercial use (the model the mesh recipe already ships)
maps._doc: hand-written workflow, not converted: ComfyUI has no template for it, so recipes/moge_maps.api.json is edited by hand. <name>__maps.png = normal map (OpenGL, +Y up, the glTF/three.js convention), <name>__maps-1.png = depth (white = near). MoGe estimates camera-space geometry, so a flat texture shot head-on gives a usable surface normal map; bumpmaps.py strips any overall tilt.

video.label: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B (text or picture to video, 1280x704, 24 fps)
video.licence: Apache-2.0: any commercial use (Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B; ComfyUI repack Comfy-Org/Wan-2.2)
video._doc: ask: {name, params: {prompt, seconds (or length = 4n+1 frames), width, height (multiples of 32; 1280x704 native, 768x768 or 512x512 are quicker), seed}, image: first frame (optional), loop: S, cutout: true, frames: true}. <name>__video.mp4; loop S crossfades the last S seconds into the first; cutout adds <name>__video-cutout.webm (VP9 with alpha, BiRefNet per frame) and frames adds its PNG frames. cutout true = BiRefNet per frame (solid things; it drops motion-blurred ones), cutout "black" = brightness key for glows, sparks and things falling on black. The negative prompt is the template's own (Chinese, as Wan was trained). Kiln (3090) 2026-11-04: 768x768 3 s 145 s cold / 109 s warm, 1280x704 4 s 261 s, 512x512 3 s 72 s; 12-16 GB in use after a clip.
